name: 39201 · Jackson, MS
findings: ZIP 39201 (Jackson) has 82 nonprofit organizations. 42 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 35 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 39201 (Jackson) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
67% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 39201 (Jackson) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 26.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 35 organizations here; 77% of all organizations here have no identified type.
